subject: Urgent request to help a stateless man reach Canada
body:
Dear {mpName},

I am writing as a constituent of {riding} to ask for your help with the permanent residence application of Teodoro Luis Castell, a stateless man who is being privately sponsored to come to Canada by Northbridge Newcomer Alliance, a Canadian nonprofit.

Teo was born stateless. He has no passport and no citizenship in any country, and he lives in Lisbon on a temporary humanitarian permit that must be renewed each year. Northbridge Newcomer Alliance submitted his complete application under private sponsorship, but after 11 months it remains in security screening, and no additional information has been provided.

His sponsors have been ready since March 2026, with housing and settlement support in place. Every month of delay is another month in which Teo has no country to call home and no secure future.

Please contact Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada and the Minister of Immigration’s office to ask for an update on Mr. Castell’s application and to request that it be reviewed as soon as possible.

Canada has a proud history of welcoming refugees through private sponsorship. I hope you will help Teo become part of it.

I would appreciate hearing what steps your office can take.

Thank you for your time.

Sincerely,

{firstName} {lastName}
{street}
{city}, {province} {postalCode}

subject: Help a sponsored stateless man reach Canada

body:

As a constituent of {riding}, I am writing about the permanent residence application of Teodoro Luis Castell, a stateless man privately sponsored by Northbridge Newcomer Alliance, a Canadian nonprofit, and to ask for your help in moving it forward.

My concern is the length and silence of the process. The application was submitted complete, yet it has remained in security screening for 11 months, and no additional information has been provided to explain the delay.

Mr. Castell has been stateless since birth, holds no passport, and lives in Lisbon on a temporary humanitarian permit renewed each year. His sponsors have had housing and settlement support in place since March 2026.

Without citizenship, he cannot travel freely, work securely, or plan a future. A process that leaves a stateless person waiting this long, with no word on why, falls short of what Canada can do.

I respectfully ask that you contact Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada and the Minister of Immigration’s office to request an update on his application and ask that it be reviewed as soon as possible.

Thank you for your consideration.
